title: 2D Ore Blocks
description: this resource pack replaces raw ores with hand-drawn pixel art of the classic ore blocks + copper thats meant to bring back smelting ore blocks into ingots
body:
so do you hate the raw ores? i sort of do. do you want the ore blocks to drop the actual block? yea. this resource pack tries to replicate that, and bring back the feel of using blocks to smelt into ingots!

if the pack says its incompatible just turn it on anyway, the pack still works.. atleast for me it does
